annotation.title_clean: Rekomendacje przygotowane pro bono, na zaproszenie i pod kierunkiem Ministerstwa Cyfryzacji, przez środowiska zainteresowane rozwojem AI w Polsce
annotation.title_en: Recommendations prepared pro bono at the invitation and under the direction of the Ministry of Digital Affairs by communities interested in AI development in Poland
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerstwo Cyfryzacji (Poland) with expert working groups
annotation.summary_en: Polish Ministry of Digital Affairs expert report (Nov 2018) with recommendations for a national AI strategy across four groups: data economy, financing and development, education, and ethics and law. It proposes ecosystem leaders, a national AI innovation fund, data-integration hub, education programmes, legal/ethical analysis and a 2018–2019 action plan. Robotics is only mentioned in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes hub-and-spoke ecosystem with leaders: AI Research Centre, National AI Innovation Fund, National Data Integration Node, Polish AI Technology Platform, Government AI Development Centre
Estimates ~9.5 bn PLN investment needed by 2023 to place Poland in top 20-25% of AI-building countries
Recommends tiered data access (sandbox, data lab, full) and public data sharing standards
Education recommendations cover AI specialists, sector professionals, users and reskilling
Ethics and law group analyses AI risks to privacy, non-discrimination, transparency and human rights
